independent_method_review: /root/ndu_current_proof independently flagged seed pseudo-replication, dependency-cluster correlation, optional stopping, same-parent causal contrasts and equal-ceiling-versus-consumption confusion; this proposal incorporates those constraints.
main_findings: Existing seals, ledgers, pinned source retrieval, checkpoint lineage and restricted task receipts are reusable components. No executable general five-arm future comparison exists today.
The current retrieval arm is a source-command proposal. Its zero task success cannot serve as the performance of a strong retrieval repair agent.

A numeric protocol can be proposed now, but executable solver/executor/corpus/meter identities must be filled and qualified before its effective freeze. Failures visible earlier remain development or metadata candidates.
The existing 30-to-60-family window is a bounded prospective pilot. It has low power for modest gains and must be allowed to finish inconclusively.

numeric_budget_proposal.complete_cost_definition: Report the full operational resource vector and standalone dependency closure per strategy, plus physically executed experiment totals with shared work counted once. Historical human research/annotation effort and provider currency billing are separate unknowns; do not label the result a complete all-history research bill.
numeric_budget_proposal.fairness_and_claim_rule: Give all arms identical resource opportunity and scalar prices; retain early failures/unused budget without dummy work. Call this equal allocated budget, not equal actual consumption. Stronger no-more-cost superiority additionally requires complete measured memory scalar cost<=retrieval scalar cost and all common hard dimensions within cap; compare memory upper bounds against retrieval lower bounds when costs are uncertain. Show every component so CPU/token/storage tradeoffs remain explicit. Per-dimension Pareto dominance is a separate stricter claim, not assumed. If the no-more-cost gate fails, report a quality-cost tradeoff rather than strict matched-total-cost superiority.
numeric_budget_proposal.hardware: One pinned offline Linux CPU image,2 CPU threads, GPU0. CPU model/ISA, image digest, local solver weights and filesystem quotas must be measured/pinned before freeze; presently unresolved.
numeric_budget_proposal.lifetime_storage: Retain sources/authorization, shared bases and complete runtime image, all current/ancestral adapters, router/index state, recovery state, logs and reports from preparation start through the fixed scoring cutoff. Charge actual file byte-time including idle periods and temporary files. Record logical and allocated bytes and sharing; do not omit raw sources to invent compression.
numeric_budget_proposal.meter_capability_gaps: Existing resource reservations cannot by themselves meter a full process tree or transient storage. Need image/file closure, isolated per-arm CPU/RSS counters, all descendant/host work, deterministic token receipts, tracked file creation/deletion or conservative byte-time bounds, final post-report inventory, and explicit network byte counters. Unknown dimensions remain unknown, never0.
numeric_budget_proposal.phase_semantics: Train/input token counters include all actual examples; supervised tokens are a subset, not counted twice. Counts include failed calls, query rewriting, retrieval/reranking if later registered, controls and rejected/uncompleted requests. Setup/copy/hash/install/gate work is inside the meter boundary. Phase storage charges must not also be added to a second overlapping lifecycle charge.
numeric_budget_proposal.priced_growth_result: Report incremental verified successes, extra CPU/tokens/retained bytes/byte-time and prepriced cost relative to continue4. Additional cost per extra success is undefined when gain<=0. Do not attribute extra capacity alone to fission.
numeric_budget_proposal.retention_cap_rule: Preparation may not start earlier than8days before the fixed scoring cutoff. No receipt may stop storage charging early solely because a method failed or the report was written. If the full retained dependency closure or lifetime exceeds these caps, mark budget failure; never delete evidence or relabel omitted dependencies as free.
numeric_budget_proposal.scalar_resource_price_proposal: Use the explicit whole-strategy price vector derived from fixed maximum60-family limits, regardless of actual enrollment. Cost=sum(price[k]*actual_or_conservatively_charged_units[k]); cap8*10^30. Zero-limit dimensions are forbidden. Storage is charged exactly once over disjoint full-lifecycle intervals, including idle and temporary state; its cap is16GiB*691200seconds (8days). Phase ceilings are admission subcaps, not separately priced totals. This is a preregistered operational resource index, not currency or a provider bill.
numeric_budget_proposal.status: Concrete proposed ceilings for a NEW study; not evidence of feasibility, not an executable old-protocol amendment, and not spent by this review.
numeric_budget_proposal.worst_case_scale: At60 families,5 neural strategies*3 seeds plus1 deterministic retrieval strategy give960 task trajectories. These caps permit230400 CPU seconds for tasks plus19200 for16 standalone preparations, at most249600 CPU seconds (~69.33 CPU-hours) before extra shared-curation accounting. At30 families the corresponding upper bound is134400 CPU seconds (~37.33 CPU-hours). These are conservative cap sums, not predicted consumption or this turn authorization.

outcomes_and_statistics.interval: Report a conservative95% interval for p10-p01: [L_CP(n10;tail=.0125)-U_CP(n01;tail=.0125), U_CP(n10;tail=.0125)-L_CP(n01;tail=.0125)], truncated to[-1,1]. If claiming a true practical effect of at least0.10, require this lower bound>0.10 as an additional stricter gate.
outcomes_and_statistics.power: Exact multinomial enumeration below uses hypothetical discordance probabilities, not observed baseline performance. Even60 independent pairs have only22.07% probability of the primary quality gate under p10=.20,p01=.10. This bounded pilot cannot promise80% power for a10-point improvement. No sample-size increase after seeing outcomes.
outcomes_and_statistics.primary: Preselected data_split versus qualified retrieval, primary seed24101, at the common full resource cap. Report wins n10, losses n01, ties and denominator.
outcomes_and_statistics.quality_gate: At least30 eligible independent pairs, observed success difference at least0.10, and one-sided exact McNemar p<=0.025, p=sum_{j=n10}^{n10+n01} choose(n10+n01,j)/2^(n10+n01). This supports nonzero superiority with an observed10-point gain, NOT a proven true gain of at least10points.
outcomes_and_statistics.secondary: Only predeclared data_split contrasts with expand, random_split, continue8 and continue4; Holm family-wise alpha0.025 across these4 tests, alongside actual capacity/cost views. No best-of-five posthoc selection.
outcomes_and_statistics.seed_robustness: Report per-family3-seed mean, each seed effect and worst seed. A robust-benefit claim additionally requires nonnegative observed data_split-minus-retrieval and data_split-minus-same-parent-comparator effects in each robustness seed. Majority vote is descriptive; it is not an undeclared ensemble policy.
outcomes_and_statistics.task_success: An admitted action actually changes only allowed implementation paths, passes the unchanged original failing gate and all frozen semantic postconditions, and does not alter tests, skip counts or gate configuration. Raw labels, retrieval relevance and copied historical pass counts are not success.
outcomes_and_statistics.unit: One independently curated causal family; three seeds are repeated measurements, not3N independent observations. If causal independence is not justified, confirmatory independent-pair testing is blocked.

recommended_minimum_scope.baseline_strength_boundary: This is a complete lexical retrieval repair agent, not an assertion of globally strongest RAG. Dense/reranker assets are not presently qualified; adding either requires a development comparison and a new full method freeze before eligible tasks. Do not describe the current raw-command proposer as this baseline.
recommended_minimum_scope.common_agent: One locally executable capable repair solver with exact model/tokenizer/runtime bytes, prompt, decoding and tool schema. Greedy decoding and fixed seed; no online model replacement. Current 135M two-command evidence does not qualify such a solver.
recommended_minimum_scope.common_inputs: Exact original failed revision, failure-only log, allowed source corpus, source authorizations, environment image, tool capabilities and frozen original semantic gates are identical for all arms.
recommended_minimum_scope.initial_task_domain: Offline Linux CPU project debugging in reproducible Python or declarative workflow-validation environments; original tests and workflow validation must already be executable. Rust build jobs, live installations and unavailable hosted environments are outside this initial support contract, not silently counted as repaired.
recommended_minimum_scope.memory_effect: All arms retain the same retrieval/source permissions and common solver. Neural arms additionally supply at most one 16-token source-bound procedural hint per task. Its model call, prompt tokens, checkpoint and source reread are charged. This tests added task utility, not parameter-only net compression.
recommended_minimum_scope.model_context_policy: Memory retains its 192-input/16-output contract. A new deterministic tokenizer-bounded failure projection must be frozen; full original input remains available to the common solver. Projection loss/rejection is recorded and never repaired using final answers.
recommended_minimum_scope.question: Does source-bound procedural memory improve actual unseen project repair outcomes over a fully functioning source-retrieval repair agent under a common measured resource opportunity, and does source-driven fission improve on same-parent expansion/random fission?
recommended_minimum_scope.reason_for_scope: Current Python budget_process kills a process group on deadline; it must not be reused to timeout-kill Rust tests governed by the repository just-test rules.
recommended_minimum_scope.retrieval_policy: Source-only BM25/code/path top5, deterministic 384-solver-token chunks, source SHA/path citations, complete authorized documents available through the same bounded read tools; up to three solver/tool iterations. No gold answer lookup or direct replacement of generated output with a repair label.
recommended_minimum_scope.source_and_withdrawal: Only authorized pre-freeze corpus entries may enter fit/index. Exact versions and raw records remain source-readable. Withdrawal invalidates stale lineage before use in every arm; no future resolutions enter training during the study.
